name: Zero-Dependency Local Gesture Engine Deployment
summary: Deploy a local browser gesture tracking interface using Python standard library and self-hosted MediaPipe JS files without external npm or pip packages.
steps: Clone repository: git clone https://github.com/zubair-trabzada/holo-gestures.git
Navigate to project folder: cd holo-gestures
Start Python server: python3 server.py
Open Chrome browser to http://localhost:4890
Allow webcam permissions and position hand in camera field of view
jarvis_use: Deploy zero-cloud, privacy-first hand gesture control interface for local desktop AI systems.

name: Local Note Vault Spatial Folder Mapping via holo.json
summary: Map local file directories and Markdown note vaults to interactive 3D floating spatial orbs by editing holo.json.
steps: Open holo.json in project root directory
Edit the folder property to target absolute path: {"folder": "/path/to/notes"}
Save holo.json and refresh local web interface
jarvis_use: Connect local text vaults and memory banks directly into a visual 3D node graph HUD.

name: Single-Pinch Spatial Node Dragging with Momentum
summary: Grab, reposition, and toss 3D floating orb nodes across the spatial canvas using single-hand pinch gestures.
steps: Pinch index finger and thumb together over target 3D orb node
Drag hand across camera field of view to translate orb position
Release pinch while in motion to apply physics momentum
jarvis_use: Directly manipulate spatial memory objects and system graph nodes with fluid hand movements.

name: Quick Pinch-Tap Object Expansion and Opening
summary: Open note cards or expand visual folder orbs into child nodes using quick pinch-tap bare-hand gestures.
steps: Position hand cursor over target folder orb or file card
Perform a rapid single-pinch tap gesture
Observe folder expand into child nodes or file open into reader panel
jarvis_use: Drill down into visual folder hierarchies and open specific memory entries touchlessly.

name: Off-Screen Flick Edge Evaporation
summary: Dismiss and close open UI panels or visual cards by flicking them towards the edge of the screen frame.
steps: Pinch or target active card panel on canvas
Perform a rapid flick motion towards any outer screen boundary
Observe panel evaporate and close upon hitting screen edge
jarvis_use: Instantly clear unwanted visual overlays or closed context panels from spatial HUD.

name: Two-Hand Stretch Full-Screen Note Expansion
summary: Expand selected document panels or note readers into full-screen focused view using two-hand stretch gestures.
steps: Target active document card with both hands in camera view
Pinch card edges with left and right index-thumb pairs
Pull hands outward away from center to trigger full-screen reader view
jarvis_use: Seamlessly expand note summaries into full-screen focus workspace for detailed viewing.

name: Two-Hand Crush Voice TTS Audio Summarization
summary: Trigger local text-to-speech audio reading of node gists using a two-hand crush spatial gesture.
steps: Select target note or summary card in HUD
Bring both hands inward into a center crushing motion
Listen to synthesized local TTS voice reading gist summary aloud
jarvis_use: Hands-free audio reading of visual nodes and status briefings in Jarvis interface.

name: Peace Sign Spatial Grid Layout Auto-Arrangement
summary: Reset floating scene clutter and neatly auto-arrange floating spatial nodes into a tidy grid using a peace sign gesture.
steps: Raise hand displaying V-shape peace sign gesture into camera view
Maintain pose until gesture detection activates
Watch floating spatial nodes transition from scattered layout into organized grid
jarvis_use: Instantly re-organize scattered desktop graph nodes into clean grid views during visual clutter.

name: GLTF Draco Model Decompression and HUD Asset Pipeline
summary: Decompress Draco-compressed 3D binary GLB models using gltf-transform CLI to ensure error-free WebGL rendering.
steps: Place source .glb model into props/ folder
Run CLI command: npx @gltf-transform/cli copy in.glb out.glb
Replace original file with decompressed .glb model
Configure initial translation, rotation, and scale in loadProps function in holo.html
jarvis_use: Prepare lightweight, fast-loading 3D visual assets and custom HUD models for local spatial UI.

name: AI Agent Calibration of Vision Gesture Thresholds
summary: Refine hand tracking gesture recognition constants in holo.html using Claude Code CLI agent prompts.
steps: Open holo-gestures repository inside Claude Code terminal
Prompt Claude Code to adjust gesture detection thresholds (e.g., PINCH_IN, PINCH_OUT, PINCH_EARN) near script header
Save modified holo.html and test gesture sensitivity in browser UI
jarvis_use: Automatically calibrate computer vision sensitivity for varying camera resolutions, lighting, and workspace bounds.

name: Synthetic Frame Spatial Probe Endpoint Debugging
summary: Verify HUD rendering state and gesture recognition routines using synthetic frame probe URL query parameters.
steps: Open browser to http://localhost:4890/?probe=1
Inspect synthetic probe output and frame render response
Verify gesture detection logic and visual asset loading without requiring live camera input
jarvis_use: Perform automated unit testing and synthetic validation of visual spatial UI components.
